svg.text: Processing workflow: Step Functions state machine
• Input is {bucket, key} from the starter Lambda. Every Lambda task calls image-processor with an action field.
• ValidateImage and SaveMetadata retry Lambda service errors 3 times. The two resize branches also retry task failures twice.
• Files that are not real images fail fast with no retries; NotifyFailure then sends the email and the run ends in MarkFailed.
